subject.title: feat(android): add Wear OS app MVP

question: Should OpenClaw core adopt and maintain this first-party Wear OS companion app after the remaining security, auth, CI, license, and proof blockers are fixed?
rationale: The branch is a large new native app surface with auth, network, persisted settings, backup, and release ownership implications; code review can identify blockers, but only maintainers can decide whether core should own Wear support and who sponsors it.

options.title: Adopt with Android owner sponsorship
options.body: Keep this PR as the canonical Wear app candidate, require rebase plus the listed blockers and real-device proof before merge, and have an Android owner sponsor the final shape.

options.title: Split foundation from UI
options.body: Extract only shared gateway/proxy primitives that maintainers want, then defer the Wear UI to a smaller follow-up or external app.

options.title: Close as not core-owned
options.body: Close the first-party Wear app proposal if maintainers do not want to own native Wear support in this repository now.

recommendation.title: Adopt with Android owner sponsorship
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the canonical Wear app candidate, require rebase plus the listed blockers and real-device proof before merge, and have an Android owner sponsor the final shape.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to obviyus and the relevant Android auth/gateway history is adjacent to the unresolved product and security questions.
